clue.text: Carrier visibly unwell, say?

indicators.note: say tells us to take the word as spoken, matching the sound of another word

parts.note: someone who looks ill is wan or pale

explanation.surface: A cryptic question: is a carrier of germs obviously sick?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carrier' suggests a disease carrier, but here it is a container for carrying water or milk.
explanation.definitionFit: A bucket is a vessel used to carry liquids, so it is a carrier.

clue.text: Lightweight food dragon finished, really empty

clue.text: Think of a number

clue.text: Current drowning every other one in crew, as ploughing through deep water

clue.text: Force criminals on to vehicle

clue.text: Trimmed material, lateral strip

clue.text: Lavatory dregs thrown out when no-one's watching?

clue.text: Popular king occupying throne raised squads of new recruits

clue.text: Habit of crow, soaring

clue.text: Bulldoze a numbered residence?

clue.text: Finally able to function in very little room?

clue.text: Bowler breaking back having reduced total

clue.text: Headache from whiplash?

clue.text: God — I don't believe it!

clue.text: National plant
